scope: Lane C7: estate hygiene audit of C:/Users/Prekzursil/.agents/memory-map.md and C:/Users/Prekzursil/.agents/memory-contract.md vs measured box state. Every path and port named in the two files was checked. Ports probed with 3 mechanically different mechanisms: netstat TCP table, raw curl HTTP (GET /api/health and a raw MCP initialize POST), and process command lines via Win32_Process. Path checks via python os.path/scandir with two known-present controls (the audited files themselves). No MCP client tools used; no config writes; no processes spawned or killed.

findings.item: Port :18765 = basic-memory daemon (memory-contract.md line 11 'http://127.0.0.1:18765/mcp'; memory-map.md line 18)
findings.evidence: netstat: 'TCP 127.0.0.1:18765 LISTENING PID 61384'. curl POST /mcp initialize -> serverInfo {name:'Basic Memory', version:'4.0.0b1'}. Win32_Process PID 61384 cmdline: 'basic-memory.exe mcp --transport streamable-http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18765 --path /mcp'. Three independent probes agree; the handshake proves the identity, not just a listener.
findings.recommendation: None. Transport claim is exact, including the /mcp path.

findings.item: Port :18812 = agent-mail (memory-contract.md line 77 ':18765/:18812/:18317 stay bound only by their owners'; memory-map.md line 27 'ports migrated 04.09.2026 to 18765/18812/18317')
findings.evidence: netstat: 'TCP 127.0.0.1:18812 LISTENING PID 39036'. curl http://127.0.0.1:18812/api/health -> {"status":"ok","timestamp":"2026-09-19T04:01:25Z"}. Win32_Process PID 39036 cmdline: 'python.exe -m mcp_agent_mail.cli serve-http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18812'. Port-migration receipt exists on disk: C:/Users/Prekzursil/Cowork/output/rail-port-migrate-sota_2026-09-04.md (5858 B).

findings.item: Port :18317 = auth2api (same contract/map port claims as above)
findings.evidence: netstat -ano -p tcp | grep listening: NO row for :18317. curl -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:18317/ -> 000 (connection failed). Detector validated: the same two probes returned LISTENING + 200/404 on :18765 and :18812, so the absence is real, not detector failure. The map documents the port as migrated-to (04.09.2026, receipt on disk), not as always-on.
findings.recommendation: Not a doc defect if auth2api is an on-demand bridge, but the contract line 'stay bound only by their owners' is presently unverifiable for :18317 (nothing binds it). Optionally annotate memory-map.md that :18317 is on-demand so a down probe is not misread as port drift.

summary: The two memory control-plane files are in unusually good shape: 19/19 paths exist, 12/12 load-bearing vault permalinks resolve, BM config parses and maps project 'main' to the documented vault, and both always-on ports are live with verified owners (:18765 basic-memory via MCP initialize handshake returning 'Basic Memory 4.0.0b1'; :18812 agent-mail via /api/health {status:ok} plus serve-http cmdline). The single runtime gap is :18317 auth2api - documented as migrated-to but currently bound by nothing (two-probe-validated absence, detector control-passed). That is consistent with an on-demand bridge, not a doc error, but it makes the contract's ':18317 stays bound only by its owners' line presently unverifiable. The real hygiene debt sits OUTSIDE the audited files: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ~/CLAUDE.md still point agent-mail at dead :8812. Verdict: memory-map.md and memory-contract.md match measured reality on every path and on 2 of 3 ports; recommend a one-line on-demand annotation for :18317 and post-audit fixes to the stale 8812 references elsewhere.
